The closing workshop column explains how paper sizing changes absorption and includes a worksheet for repeating the test at home.

traps.note: The retailer, new-product subject and product-card layout tempt promotional, but the recurring issue delivers comparative test findings and educational guidance rather than a sales pitch, making newsletter correct.
